description: Revert to the proven aggressive Matrix LR (0.11) and Embedding LR (1.4) configuration with Depth 10, as the previous best result (0.9800) was achieved with a conservative LR (0.08) that likely under-utilized the 5-minute time budget, whereas historical data confirms the aggressive setup achieves better convergence speed (~0.983-0.984 bpb) within the limit.
